settings.title: Settings
settings.empty.title: Settings are not ready
settings.empty.message: Your profile has not been created yet. Try again to set it up.
settings.profile.title: Profile
settings.profile.subtitle: Add your details
settings.profile.name: Name
settings.profile.birthDateExplainer: Your age sharpens the energy estimate. Without it, Forge falls back to a wider default.
settings.profile.sexExplainer: Used only in the energy and body-composition formulas. You can leave it unspecified.
settings.profile.bodyExplainer: Weight can be %@ and height %@. Both feed your energy target and every load estimate.
settings.profile.activityExplainer: Describe your day away from the gym. Forge adds the work of your sessions on top of this.
settings.goals.title: Goals
settings.goals.footer: The first goal you pick is the one Forge plans around. Tap a goal again to remove it.
settings.goals.emptyExplainer: With nothing chosen, Forge plans for general fitness.
settings.goals.priorityNone: Nothing prioritised. Weekly volume is spread evenly across muscle groups.
settings.goals.prioritiesFooter: Priorities receive more weekly sets. Everything else still gets enough to keep progressing.
settings.goals.experienceEffect: Forge picks exercises up to %@ level and leaves about %lld reps in reserve.
settings.training.title: Training
settings.training.noDaysExplainer: Pick at least one day so Forge can schedule your sessions.
settings.training.availabilityFooter: Your program is built to fit these days and this session length.
settings.training.autoProgression.detail: Adjust load and reps from how your last session went
settings.training.deload.detail: Offer a lighter week when fatigue builds up
settings.training.autoregulation.detail: Use your check-in to tune the day's load
settings.training.rirOverride.detail: Otherwise Forge takes it from your experience level
settings.training.effectiveRIR: Sets are prescribed with about %lld reps left in reserve.
settings.training.restFooter: The timer uses whichever value fits the exercise. You can always change it mid-set.
settings.training.restAutoStart.detail: The timer begins the moment you log a set
settings.training.keepAwake.detail: The screen stays on while a workout is running
settings.training.showAnimations.detail: Play the animation on the exercise you are working on
settings.training.limitationsNone: Nothing selected. Every movement pattern stays available.
settings.training.limitationsFooter: Forge simply schedules around these. They stay on your device and are never treated as a diagnosis.
settings.equipment.title: Equipment
settings.equipment.presetFooter: A preset fills in the list below. Changing any single item moves you to a custom setup.
settings.equipment.emptyExplainer: Nothing selected, so Forge plans bodyweight sessions.
settings.equipment.outOfServiceFooter: Mark anything broken or taken. Forge picks alternatives until you switch it back.
settings.equipment.incrementsFooter: Every load Forge suggests is rounded onto these, so it only ever asks for a weight you can actually make.
settings.equipment.platesFooter: List each plate size your gym stocks.
settings.equipment.dumbbellsFooter: The sizes on your rack. Forge will not suggest a dumbbell you do not have.
settings.equipment.ladderEmpty.title: Nothing listed
settings.equipment.ladderEmpty.message: Forge needs at least one weight here to round loads onto.
settings.equipment.lastWeight: Keep at least one weight, so loads still have something to round onto.
settings.nutrition.title: Nutrition
settings.nutrition.enabled.detail: Show the food log, daily targets and meal suggestions
settings.nutrition.disabledExplainer: The Nutrition tab is hidden. Your food log is kept and returns when you switch this back on.
settings.nutrition.dietNoExclusions: This diet excludes nothing on its own.
settings.nutrition.restrictionsFooter: Anything selected here is filtered out completely. Those foods never appear in a suggestion, rather than simply ranking lower.
settings.nutrition.mealsExplainer: Your daily targets are split across this many meals.
settings.nutrition.paceMaintenance: Your targets are set to hold your current weight.
settings.nutrition.paceGain: Around %@ gained a week, as an estimate.
settings.nutrition.paceLose: Around %@ lost a week, as an estimate.
settings.nutrition.dynamicAdjustment.det: Nudge your calories when the weight trend drifts from the plan
settings.nutrition.waterFooter: A rough guide rather than a rule. Warm days and long sessions ask for more.
settings.units.title: Units
settings.units.mixed: You are using a mix of metric and imperial units, which is perfectly fine.
settings.units.footer: Units change only what you see. Nothing you have logged is converted or rewritten.
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.appearance.footer: System follows your device's light and dark setting.
settings.appearance.sampleBody: Three sets of eight, two reps left in reserve.
settings.appearance.accessibilityNote: Forge follows your text size, contrast and reduced-motion settings. Those live in iOS Settings, under Accessibility.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.deviceFooter: Forge uses whatever language your iPhone is set to.
settings.language.footer: Choosing a language here changes Forge only, and it applies straight away.
settings.notifications.title: Notifications
settings.notifications.enable.detail: Every reminder below is scheduled on this device
settings.notifications.denied: Notifications are turned off for Forge in iOS Settings.
settings.notifications.permissionFooter: Nothing arrives from a server. Forge has no push service and no remote notifications.
settings.notifications.trainingAllDays: Repeats every day, because no training days are set.
settings.notifications.restTimer.detail: Useful when you leave the app between sets
settings.notifications.weightFooter: A reading at the same time each day keeps your weight trend steady.
settings.notifications.mealsEmpty.title: No times yet
settings.notifications.mealsEmpty.messag: Add a time and Forge will remind you to log that meal.
settings.notifications.mealsFooter: Up to six a day, each repeating daily.
settings.health.title: Health
settings.health.unavailable.title: Health is not available
settings.health.unavailable.message: This device has no Health app, so Forge cannot connect to it. Everything else works as normal.
settings.health.enable.detail: Optional. Every part of Forge works without it
settings.health.denied: Health access was declined. You can change it in iOS Settings, under Health.
settings.health.connectionFooter: iOS asks you about each data type separately, and you can change any answer later.
settings.health.readBodyMass.detail: Keeps your weight trend up to date
settings.health.readSteps.detail: Adds your daily movement to that estimate
settings.health.readSleep.detail: Feeds the readiness estimate on your check-in
settings.health.readFooter: Health never tells an app whether reading was allowed, so Forge can only say what it asks for. Anything it reads stays on this device.
settings.health.writeWorkouts.detail: Saves each finished session as a workout
settings.health.writeBodyMassNote: Weigh-ins you log in Forge are saved to Health too, when you allow it.
settings.health.privacy: Health data is read into memory to work out what is on screen. It is never sent anywhere, and Forge has no account and no server.
settings.data.title: Data
settings.data.import.emptyBackup.title: This backup is empty
settings.data.import.emptyBackup.message: The file is valid but holds no workouts, programs or food entries, so restoring it would change nothing.
settings.data.reset.item.history: Every workout and set you have logged
settings.data.reset.item.nutrition: Your food log, custom foods, saved meals and recipes
settings.data.reset.item.settings: All settings, including units and language
settings.about.title: About
settings.about.tagline: Your training and nutrition, kept on your device.
settings.about.datasetFailed: The exercise library could not be read.
settings.about.foodDatabaseFailed: The food database could not be read.
settings.about.bundledDataFooter: Both ship inside the app and work with no connection.
settings.about.ack.dataset: Exercise data and instructions by Hasan Emir Yıldırım, under the MIT licence.
settings.about.ack.media: Exercise thumbnails and animations are original 3D renders made for this app.
settings.about.ack.apple: Built entirely with Apple's frameworks. Forge contains no third-party code.
settings.about.rerunOnboarding.detail: Answer the setup questions again to rebuild your profile and program.
settings.about.rerunOnboarding.confirmMe: Your workouts, personal records and food log are all kept. You only answer the setup questions again.
settings.legal.title: Legal and privacy
settings.legal.media.body: The thumbnails and animations shown with every exercise are original 3D renders made for this app from its own athlete model. No third-party artwork is used.
settings.legal.media.notMit: The artwork is not covered by the MIT licence below. All rights to it are reserved by the app's author.
settings.legal.dataset.body: Exercise names, categories, equipment, target muscles and the step-by-step instructions come from an open dataset by Hasan Emir Yıldırım, released under the MIT licence.
settings.legal.dataset.distinction: The data is MIT-licensed. The artwork is not.
settings.legal.food.usda: The built-in food database is compiled from USDA FoodData Central. Works of the United States Government are in the public domain, so no licence or credit is required — it is given here anyway.
settings.legal.food.estimates: Values are rounded for everyday use. They are estimates, not laboratory measurements.
settings.legal.food.openFoodFacts: Searching for a packaged product or scanning a barcode looks it up on Open Food Facts, whose data is published under the Open Database Licence (ODbL).
settings.legal.privacy.local: Everything you log — profile, programs, workouts, weigh-ins and food — is stored only on this device.
settings.legal.privacy.noAnalytics: There is no analytics, no crash reporting, no advertising identifier and no third-party framework of any kind.
settings.legal.privacy.noAccount: There is no account, no login and no sync service. Nothing is uploaded.
settings.legal.privacy.network: Forge makes one kind of outbound request, and only when you ask for it: a food lookup on Open Food Facts, carrying just your search term or the barcode.
settings.legal.privacy.optIn: Health, the camera and notifications are each off until you turn them on, and every feature works without them.
settings.legal.privacy.yourData: You can export everything, restore a backup or delete the lot under Settings, in Data.
settings.legal.privacy.notMedical: Forge estimates readiness, suggests loads and calculates energy and macronutrient targets. These are estimates from documented formulas — not measurements, diagnoses or medical advice.
settings.legal.software.apple: Forge is built with Apple's frameworks under the Apple Developer Program Licence Agreement, and has no third-party packages.
settings.legal.document.missing: This document is not included in this build of Forge.
